description: Threads members started on the Power Players forum (the Melting Pot), the same ones the site shows to everyone: title, a short excerpt, the member's username, state, votes, reply count and a link. Hidden, unapproved and sensitive posts are left out. Filter by type ('general' or 'soapbox'), a two-letter state, or a search phrase; sort by 'new' (default), 'top' or 'active'. Petitions and polls have their own tools (list_petitions, list_polls). Members' posts are opinions; quote them as one member's view. Use read_forum_thread for the full text and replies.
name: list_forum_threads
title: List forum threads
